description: Paid routes require a funded Base USDC wallet. Use readfetch-client / @readfetch/client or the MCP signing proxy (@readfetch/mcp-x402-proxy). Direct calls without a signing client will stop at 402. Extract one heading or one CSS selector from a public page instead of the whole document. Returns matched Markdown or text, title, chars, content_sha256, and billed. If the heading is missing, returns HTTP 200 with empty text and `available_headings` so you can retry. `mode`: fast (plain HTTP) or render (default, Chromium when the page blocks HTTP). `max_chars` truncates output (default 8000, max 20000). Prefer readfetch_text for full articles; readfetch_scrape when content needs JavaScript.

format.description: Output flavour for the matched section (markdown default).

heading.description: Heading text to match (case-insensitive, whitespace-normalised). Required unless `selector` is set — send exactly one of `heading` or `selector`, not both.

max_chars.description: Truncate matched text after this many characters.

mode.description: fast = HTTP-first; render = one browser pass when plain HTTP fails (default).

selector.description: CSS selector; up to 20 matches concatenated. Required unless `heading` is set — use selector when the section has no stable heading text.

url.description: Public page URL to extract from.

name: readfetch_section
